parameters.note: This special regulation applies to the Tuolumne River from O'Shaughnessy Dam (Hetch Hetchy Reservoir) downstream to Clavey River Falls.

candidates.summary: Special regulation applies from O'Shaughnessy Dam (Hetch Hetchy Reservoir) downstream to Clavey River Falls

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife
candidates.summary: Open all year from O'Shaughnessy Dam to Clavey River Falls

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Only artificial lures may be used; live or dead bait is prohibited.

candidates.summary: Artificial lures only, no bait, from O'Shaughnessy Dam to Clavey River Falls

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.counting_rule: 2 trout daily bag limit; possession limit equals one daily bag limit (2) per the general provision at 14 CCR §7.50(a) absent a separately stated possession limit.

candidates.summary: 2 trout daily bag and possession limit from O'Shaughnessy Dam to Clavey River Falls

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Closed to fishing November 1 through December 31 from La Grange Dam downstream to Hickman Bridge.

candidates.summary: Open January 1 through October 31 from La Grange Dam downstream to Hickman Bridge

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Applies from La Grange Dam downstream to Hickman Bridge.

candidates.summary: Only artificial lures with barbless hooks may be used from La Grange Dam downstream to Hickman Bridge

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.counting_rule: 2 hatchery trout or hatchery steelhead per day, combined; 4 in possession, combined.

candidates.summary: 2 hatchery trout or hatchery steelhead daily bag, 4 in possession, from La Grange Dam downstream to Hickman Bridge

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Closed to fishing November 1 through December 31 from Hickman Bridge to the mouth.

candidates.summary: Open January 1 through October 31 from Hickman Bridge to the mouth

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Bait may be used from Jan. 1 through Oct. 31. From Apr. 1 through the Friday preceding the fourth Saturday in May, bait may be used only with single hooks having a gap between 1/2 and 1 inch, or with multiple hooks having a gap between 1/4 and 1/2 inch.

candidates.summary: Bait allowed Jan. 1–Oct. 31 from Hickman Bridge to the mouth; Apr. 1 through the Friday before the fourth Saturday in May, bait restricted to specific hook-gap sizes

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.counting_rule: 2 hatchery trout or hatchery steelhead per day, combined; 4 in possession, combined.

candidates.summary: 2 hatchery trout or hatchery steelhead daily bag, 4 in possession, from Hickman Bridge to the mouth

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Only trout/steelhead showing a healed adipose fin clip may be retained as "hatchery" fish; wild fish with the adipose fin intact must be released immediately and do not count toward the bag or possession limit. Applies to the lower river below La Grange Dam.

candidates.summary: Wild (adipose-fin-intact) steelhead and trout must be released unharmed; only adipose-fin-clipped hatchery fish may be kept

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Anglers 16 years of age or older must have a valid California sport fishing license.

candidates.summary: California sport fishing license required for anglers 16+
